Frequently asked questions
How do I cancel?
Google Play → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions. If you cancel, Premium lasts until the end of the period.
Does it work on my other devices?
Yes. Premium is active on every device where you sign in with the same Google account.
What happens to my drawings if I go back to Free?
Nothing is deleted. Only Premium tools and items lock again; what you already added stays in your drawings.
